agents.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAgentBudget fills the gap:\u003c/strong\u003e Real-time, dollar-denominated, per-session budget enforcement that <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What's New in v0.4.0 — LangChain/LangGraph coverage, safer concurrency & costs</h2><a id="user-content-whats-new-in-v040--langchainlanggraph-coverage-safer-concurrency--costs" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What's New in v0.4.0 — LangChain/LangGraph coverage, safer concurrency & costs" href="#whats-new-in-v040--langchainlanggraph-coverage-safer-concurrency--costs"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>LangChain / LangGraph</strong> — <code>LangChainBudgetCallback</code> now tracks modern chat-model usage (<code>usage_metadata</code>) and LangGraph runs, adds optional tool-cost tracking, and a context-manager lifecycle with <code>on_hard_limit</code> support. (#26)</li>
<li><strong>Per-request isolation in drop-in mode</strong> — <code>init()</code> / <code>teardown()</code> session state is now scoped per thread and per async task, so concurrent requests no longer overwrite or tear down each other's sessions. (#20)</li>
<li><strong>Cost validation</strong> — negative, <code>NaN</code>, and infinite costs are now rejected with <code>InvalidCost</code> before they can corrupt the ledger. (#21)</li>
<li><strong>Streaming, fixed</strong> — cost is recorded even when you break out of a stream early or an async stream ends incompletely, and OpenAI's <code>stream_options={"include_usage": True}</code> is now injected automatically. (#15)</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">See the <a href="/AgentBudget/agentbudget/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md">changelog</a> for the full list. Earlier 0.3.0 features — streaming, <code>wrap_client()</code>, <code>finalization_reserve</code>, <code>would_exceed()</code>, and OpenRouter model names — are documented below.</p>

<p dir="auto">AgentBudget is an open-source Python SDK that puts a hard dollar limit on any AI agent session. It wraps LLM calls, tool calls, and external API requests with real-time cost tracking and automatic circuit breaking — so your agent can never silently burn through your budget.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>One line to set a budget. Zero infrastructure to manage. Works with any LLM provider.</strong></p>
<hr>

<p dir="auto">Two lines. Zero code changes to your existing agent.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="import agentbudget

)

print(agentbudget.remaining())  # e.g. 4.9965

<p dir="auto"><code>agentbudget.init()</code> patches OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs so every call is tracked automatically. The patch is process-wide, but the active budget/session is isolated to the current thread or async task. <code>teardown()</code> only closes the current context's session, and the SDKs are unpatched after the last active context exits.</p>
<p dir="auto">For concurrent apps:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Call <code>agentbudget.init()</code> inside each request thread that needs its own session.</li>
<li><code>asyncio</code> tasks inherit the current session at task creation; call <code>agentbudget.init()</code> inside the task to give it an independent session.</li>
<li>For explicit server-side scoping, <code>wrap_client()</code> or manual <code>BudgetSession</code> usage is still the most predictable option.</li>
</ul>

    response = session.wrap(openai.chat.completions.create(
        model="gpt-4o",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Research competitors in the CRM space"}]
    ))

    # Track tool/API calls with known costs
    result = session.track(call_serp_api(query="CRM market"), cost=0.01)

    # No silent overruns. No surprise bills.

        <span class="pl-s1">model</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"gpt-4o"</span>,

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Streaming Support</h3><a id="user-content-streaming-support" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Streaming Support" href="#streaming-support"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Streaming responses (<code>stream=True</code>) are fully tracked. Cost is recorded even if you break out of the stream early — chunks pass through to your code unchanged.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# Drop-in mode — works automatically
agentbudget.init("$5.00")
client = openai.OpenAI()

stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize this report"}],
    stream=True,  # include_usage is added automatically for OpenAI
)
for chunk in stream:
    print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or "", end="")

print(agentbudget.spent())  # cost recorded after the stream"><pre><span class="pl-c"># Drop-in mode — works automatically</span>
<span class="pl-s1">agentbudget</span>.<span class="pl-c1">init</span>(<span class="pl-s">"$5.00"</span>)
<span class="pl-s1">client</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">openai</span>.<span class="pl-c1">OpenAI</span>()

<span class="pl-s1">stream</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">client</span>.<span class="pl-c1">chat</span>.<span class="pl-c1">completions</span>.<span class="pl-c1">create</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">model</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"gpt-4o"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">messages</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>[{<span class="pl-s">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"user"</span>, <span class="pl-s">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"Summarize this report"</span>}],
    <span class="pl-s1">stream</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">True</span>,  <span class="pl-c"># include_usage is added automatically for OpenAI</span>
)
<span class="pl-k">for</span> <span class="pl-s1">chunk</span> <span class="pl-c1">in</span> <span class="pl-s1">stream</span>:
    <span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s1">chunk</span>.<span class="pl-c1">choices</span>[<span class="pl-c1">0</span>].<span class="pl-c1">delta</span>.<span class="pl-c1">content</span> <span class="pl-c1">or</span> <span class="pl-s">""</span>, <span class="pl-s1">end</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">""</span>)

<span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s1">agentbudget</span>.<span class="pl-c1">spent</span>())  <span class="pl-c"># cost recorded after the stream</span></pre></div>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>OpenAI note:</strong> In drop-in mode (<code>init()</code>) and with <code>wrap_client()</code>, AgentBudget automatically adds <code>stream_options={"include_usage": True}</code> so token counts appear on the final chunk — you don't need to pass it yourself (an explicit value is always respected). Anthropic streams always include usage. The only time you must set it manually is if you call the OpenAI API directly and pass the response to <code>session.wrap()</code>.</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Async streaming works the same way:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="async for chunk in await client.chat.completions.create(stream=True, ...):
    ..."><pre><span class="pl-k">async</span> <span class="pl-k">for</span> <span class="pl-s1">chunk</span> <span class="pl-c1">in</span> <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-s1">client</span>.<span class="pl-c1">chat</span>.<span class="pl-c1">completions</span>.<span class="pl-c1">create</span>(<span class="pl-s1">stream</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">True</span>, ...):
    ...</pre></div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Explicit Per-Client Tracking</h3><a id="user-content-explicit-per-client-tracking" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Explicit Per-Client Tracking" href="#explicit-per-client-tracking"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">By default, <code>agentbudget.init()</code> installs process-wide OpenAI/Anthropic patches and resolves the active session from the current thread/task context at call time. If you need finer control — multiple budgets, different clients per task, or just prefer explicit scope — use <code>wrap_client()</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="from agentbudget import AgentBudget
import agentbudget
import openai

budget = AgentBudget(max_spend="$5.00")
with budget.session() as session:
    # Only this client instance is tracked
    client = agentbudget.wrap_client(openai.OpenAI(), session)
    response = client.chat.completions.create(...)   # tracked

    other = openai.OpenAI()
    other.chat.completions.create(...)               # NOT tracked"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">agentbudget</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">AgentBudget</span>
<span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">agentbudget</span>
<span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">openai</span>

<span class="pl-s1">budget</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">AgentBudget</span>(<span class="pl-s1">max_spend</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"$5.00"</span>)
<span class="pl-k">with</span> <span class="pl-s1">budget</span>.<span class="pl-c1">session</span>() <span class="pl-k">as</span> <span class="pl-s1">session</span>:
    <span class="pl-c"># Only this client instance is tracked</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">client</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">agentbudget</span>.<span class="pl-c1">wrap_client</span>(<span class="pl-s1">openai</span>.<span class="pl-c1">OpenAI</span>(), <span class="pl-s1">session</span>)
    <span class="pl-s1">response</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">client</span>.<span class="pl-c1">chat</span>.<span class="pl-c1">completions</span>.<span class="pl-c1">create</span>(...)   <span class="pl-c"># tracked</span>

    <span class="pl-s1">other</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">openai</span>.<span class="pl-c1">OpenAI</span>()
    <span class="pl-s1">other</span>.<span class="pl-c1">chat</span>.<span class="pl-c1">completions</span>.<span class="pl-c1">create</span>(...)               <span class="pl-c"># NOT tracked</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Works with <code>openai.OpenAI</code>, <code>openai.AsyncOpenAI</code>, <code>anthropic.Anthropic</code>, and <code>anthropic.AsyncAnthropic</code>.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Finalization Reserve</h3><a id="user-content-finalization-reserve" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Finalization Reserve" href="#finalization-reserve"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Prevent your agent from being cut off mid-task. Reserve a fraction of the budget exclusively for the final response step:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="budget = AgentBudget(

    finalization_reserve=0.05,  # hard limit fires at $0.95, last $0.05 stays free
)"><pre><span class="pl-s1">budget</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">AgentBudget</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">max_spend</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"$1.00"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">finalization_reserve</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">0.05</span>,  <span class="pl-c"># hard limit fires at $0.95, last $0.05 stays free</span>
)</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For manual control, check before the final call:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="with budget.session() as session:

<p dir="auto">Three levels of protection against runaway spend:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="budget = AgentBudget(
    max_spend="$5.00",
    soft_limit=0.9,               # Warn at 90% spent
    max_repeated_calls=10,        # Trip after 10 repeated calls
    loop_window_seconds=60.0,     # Within a 60-second window
    on_soft_limit=lambda r: print("90% budget used"),
    on_hard_limit=lambda r: alert_ops_team(r),
    on_loop_detected=lambda r: print("Loop detected!"),
)"><pre><span class="pl-s1">budget</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">AgentBudget</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">max_spend</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"$5.00"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">soft_limit</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">0.9</span>,               <span class="pl-c"># Warn at 90% spent</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">max_repeated_calls</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">10</span>,        <span class="pl-c"># Trip after 10 repeated calls</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">loop_window_seconds</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">60.0</span>,     <span class="pl-c"># Within a 60-second window</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">on_soft_limit</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-k">lambda</span> <span class="pl-s1">r</span>: <span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s">"90% budget used"</span>),
    <span class="pl-s1">on_hard_limit</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-k">lambda</span> <span class="pl-s1">r</span>: <span class="pl-en">alert_ops_team</span>(<span class="pl-s1">r</span>),
    <span class="pl-s1">on_loop_detected</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-k">lambda</span> <span class="pl-s1">r</span>: <span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s">"Loop detected!"</span>),
)</pre></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Soft limit</strong> — Fires a callback when spending exceeds a threshold. Agent can wrap up gracefully.</li>
<li><strong>Hard limit</strong> — Raises <code>BudgetExhausted</code>. No more calls allowed.</li>
<li><strong>Loop detection</strong> — Catches infinite loops before they drain the budget.</li>
</ul>
